title: The Ash Foundry
pages:
The portal let me through without asking my name.

The Nether is the one place he built that I did not have to learn. It is exactly as the stories had it. Hot. Loud. Honest about wanting to kill you.

A foundry, here, in the ash. Furnaces still lit, slag still moving, nobody tending any of it.

He always liked a fire that kept going without him.

I found his old boots by the crucible.

He was never a man who left things where they could be found. The place put them there so that I would.
